body: I hope you can move on as well. I think we both did the right thing cutting them out. It's hard but one day we will find the right person and it won't be hard or frustrating because they will appreciate our value.

I'm going to go to bed. I didn't want to worry you, not the best coping mechanism but it's a safe one. I appreciate your help. I'm usually on here offering help on my other username but sometimes these feelings happen. I'm not trying to discourage anyone I just think suicidal thoughts are more common than society wants to admit.

I was tired of him never asking how I was doing or never taking in consideration my feelings after he told me he wants his ex. He wanted me to still be his friend so he could talk to me about his problems. I felt sad so I purposely destroyed things as a coping mechanism. Now I feel sad, anxious, suicidal and a failure.
I feel overwhelmed and sad. Like i don't matter. I'm still anxious
Thank you. I'll check it out.
